players.product: Power-first greenfield AI data-center campuses on 15-year triple-net leases (River Bend LA for Anthropic; Beacon Point TX) - ex-Bitcoin-mining platform (American Bitcoin affiliate)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 earnings release: the second 15-year, 352 MW Beacon Point IT lease signed after quarter-end with the Phase 1 tenant represents approximately $655.0 million of expected average annual NOI on a triple-net, take-or-pay basis, bringing expected average annual NOI across the campus to approximately $1.3 billion. Beacon Point is targeted for initial data hall delivery in the third quarter of 2027, and River Bend's buildout progress during the quarter included receipt of initial deliveries of long-lead equipment.
quarterly_data.figure: Beacon Point second lease ~$655.0 million expected average annual NOI; campus ~$1.3 billion; Beacon Point initial data hall delivery Q3 2027

quarterly_data.signal: As of June 30, 2026 Hut 8's development pipeline totalled approximately 8,660 MW: 5,400 MW of Energy Capacity Under Diligence, 1,880 MW Under Exclusivity, 50 MW Under Development and 1,330 MW Under Construction, the last comprising 330 MW at River Bend and 1,000 MW at Beacon Point (including 500 MW of Beacon Point Phase 2 capacity that advanced to Under Construction after June 30, 2026).
quarterly_data.figure: pipeline ~8,660 MW: diligence 5,400 MW, exclusivity 1,880 MW, development 50 MW, construction 1,330 MW (River Bend 330 MW, Beacon Point 1,000 MW)
